description: Unit test code for the unknown payload decoder in HTTP/2 frame decoding, including test setup, mock listener, and parameterized tests for various payload lengths.

classes.name: UnknownPayloadDecoderPeer
classes.description: Provides access to the current unknown frame type and flags affecting payload decoding for testing purposes.

classes.name: Listener
classes.description: A test listener class that collects frame parts and logs frame events.

classes.name: UnknownPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: A parameterized test class for testing unknown payload decoders with various payload lengths.

methods.name: FrameType
methods.description: Returns the current unknown frame type used in tests.

methods.name: FlagsAffectingPayloadDecoding
methods.description: Returns flags that influence payload decoding, always zero in this test.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles the start of an unknown frame, forwarding to the frame parts collector.

methods.name: OnUnknownPayload
methods.description: Handles payload data of an unknown frame, forwarding to the frame parts collector.

methods.name: OnUnknownEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of an unknown frame, forwarding to the frame parts collector.

methods.name: UnknownPayloadDecoderTest
methods.description: Constructor initializes test with a random unsupported frame type and payload length.
